subject: cat-act-2011-lqa
citation: Cat Act 2011 (WA), No. 55 of 2011, consolidated version 00-l0-01, currency start 25 Sep 2025
in_force_statement: Marked 'Current' on the WA Legislation website on 2026-10-01. Uncommenced amendments: Dog Amendment (Stop Puppy Farming) Act 2021 ss. 50-61 (to be proclaimed) and Evidence Act 2025 s. 492(1) (18 Sep 2027). Two Bills amending the Act are before the Legislative Council: Nos. 53-1 and 40-1.
scope: 1A-2A run of 2026-10-01. Scope of the whole run: Part 1 and Part 2 of the Act, and the regulation provisions Parts 1-2 depend on. Every relevant document is gathered whole.
note: Assembled by an agent at 1A-2A, independently of the earlier canon subject cat-act-2011 (nothing in it was read; its sources folder was listed by name only, and no file in it was used, because every document was fetched directly). Documents with integrity.local_path are held under sources/. Documents with a sha256 and no local_path were downloaded and fingerprinted but not held, for the licence reason given; the fingerprint lets a later copy be checked. Documents with an empty integrity were not retrieved.
